<!-- Shared DuckDB-WASM wiring for every live recipe page — one instance per
     page, rebuilt only by an explicit Retry (see cancer-on-ice#119/#120:
     stacking several undisposed instances in one tab was the actual cause
     of the "Maximum call stack size exceeded" failure originally blamed on
     query size). Included with {{< include _duckdb-shared.qmd >}} at the
     top of each recipe page, before that page's own `sql`/`queryState`
     cells — factored here once instead of copied per page. -->

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
CATALOG_ENDPOINT = "https://icegate-canceronice.seandavi.workers.dev"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Standard USPS state FIPS codes — public, static, and needed for a
// selector before any catalog connection exists, so it's a plain array
// here rather than a live query. geo_id in the catalog is 'state:<fips>'.

  ["01","Alabama"],["02","Alaska"],["04","Arizona"],["05","Arkansas"],["06","California"],
  ["08","Colorado"],["09","Connecticut"],["10","Delaware"],["11","District of Columbia"],

  ["23","Maine"],["24","Maryland"],["25","Massachusetts"],["26","Michigan"],["27","Minnesota"],
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Incrementing this mutable is the ONLY thing that rebuilds dbState below.
// Selector changes on the page never touch it — they only re-run that
// page's own queryState, reusing the same connection.
mutable dbGeneration = 0
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
retryButton = {
  const btn = html`<button>Retry connection</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => { mutable dbGeneration = dbGeneration + 1; };
  return btn;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Loads the SAME pinned duckdb-wasm build the explorer app uses (Quarto's
// own OJS stdlib DuckDBClient is an older bundled client that cannot ATTACH
// an Iceberg REST catalog). Depends only on dbGeneration, so it runs once
// per page load and again only on Retry.
dbState = {
  dbGeneration; // reactive dependency — Retry increments this to rebuild the instance
  const t0 = performance.now();
  try {
    const duckdb = await import(
      "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@duckdb/duckdb-wasm@1.33.1-dev57.0/dist/duckdb-browser.mjs"
    );
    const bundle = await duckdb.selectBundle(duckdb.getJsDelivrBundles());
    const tBundle = performance.now();
    const workerUrl = URL.createObjectURL(
      new Blob([`importScripts("${bundle.mainWorker}");`], { type: "text/javascript" })
    );
    const worker = new Worker(workerUrl);
    const db = new duckdb.AsyncDuckDB(new duckdb.ConsoleLogger(duckdb.LogLevel.WARNING), worker);
    await db.instantiate(bundle.mainModule, bundle.pthreadWorker);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(workerUrl);
    const conn = await db.connect();
    const tInstantiate = performance.now();
    await conn.query("INSTALL iceberg; LOAD iceberg; INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;");
    const tExtensions = performance.now();
    await conn.query(
      `ATTACH 'canceronice' AS coi (TYPE ICEBERG, ENDPOINT '${CATALOG_ENDPOINT}', AUTHORIZATION_TYPE 'none');`
    );
    const tAttach = performance.now();
    // Tear this instance down fully before the cell is ever replaced (a
    // future Retry, or navigating away) — never leave a stale worker + WASM
    // heap running alongside a new one.
    invalidation.then(async () => {
      try { await conn.close(); } catch {}
      try { await db.terminate(); } catch {}
    });
    return {
      status: "ready",
      conn,
      timings: {
        instantiate: tInstantiate - tBundle,
        extensions: tExtensions - tInstantiate,
        attach: tAttach - tExtensions,
        total: tAttach - t0
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return { status: "error", error };
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function rowsFromArrow(table) {
  const fields = table.schema.fields.map((f) => f.name);
  return table.toArray().map((r) => {
    const o = {};
    for (const f of fields) {
      let v = r[f];
      if (typeof v === "bigint") v = Number(v);
      o[f] = v;
    }
    return o;
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Shared status line: "connecting" / a query-failed or catalog-unreachable
// callout with Retry / a ready line with timings. Every recipe page calls
// this from its own display cell as renderStatus(dbState, queryState).
function renderStatus(dbState, queryState) {
  if (dbState.status === "error")
    return html`<p class="status-error"><strong>Catalog unreachable:</strong> ${dbState.error?.message ?? dbState.error}.
      Large-table reads can fail intermittently in a long-lived tab
      (<a href="https://github.com/seandavi/cancer-on-ice/issues/120">cancer-on-ice#120</a>) —
      try Retry, or a hard refresh if Retry doesn't help.</p><p>${retryButton}</p>`;
  if (dbState.status !== "ready")
    return html`<p class="recipe-status"><em>Connecting to the catalog and loading DuckDB-WASM…</em></p>`;
  if (queryState.status === "error")
    return html`<p class="status-error"><strong>Query failed:</strong> ${queryState.error?.message ?? queryState.error}</p><p>${retryButton}</p>`;
  if (queryState.status !== "ready")
    return html`<p class="recipe-status"><em>Running query…</em></p>`;
  return html`<p class="recipe-status">DuckDB-WASM ready in ${dbState.timings.total.toFixed(0)} ms
    (extensions ${dbState.timings.extensions.toFixed(0)} ms, ATTACH ${dbState.timings.attach.toFixed(0)} ms).
    This query: ${queryState.ms.toFixed(0)} ms, ${queryState.rows?.length ?? 0} rows.</p>`;
}
```
